# Donald Trump approval rating falls to 32%, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds

Portrait of Victoria E. Freile Victoria E. Freile

New York Connect Team

Sept. 22, 2026, 11:17 a.m. ET

President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 32%, the lowest level of his political career, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll.

The poll, released Monday, Sept. 21, found that 32% of Americans approved of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous Reuters/Ipsos poll. [...] Trump's approval rating among Republicans also fell in the latest poll. Seventy-three percent of Republicans approved of his job performance, down from 82% in the previous week's Reuters/Ipsos poll.
